versions.content: function operator== [SWS_CORE_00780] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 template <typename T, typename E> bool operator== (const Result < T, E > &lhs, const Result < T, E > &rhs); Compare two Result instances for equality. A Result that contains a value is unequal to every Result containing an error. A Result containing a value is equal to another Result only if both contain the same type, and either that type is void or the value of that type compares equal. A Result containing an error is equal to another Result only if both contain the same error type, and the contained errors compare equal.
